deep_read.description: Creative Translator and Copywriter (Arabic and English) Department: Marketing Function: Creative Studio Reports to Creative Manager Location: Permanent Remote About the organisation Our client is an Abu Dhabi-based diversified holding and platform-building group focused on developing and scaling businesses across strategically important sectors. Its portfolio includes mobility, aviation, fintech, insurance, healthcare, mining and energy, professional services, and other high-impact opportunities. The group is building an integrated marketing function covering strategy, brand, creative, digital, insights, operations, and growth. Why join Work across several businesses, sectors, audiences, and commercial models rather than supporting a single brand. Help shape the standards, systems, and working practices of a growing group marketing function. Collaborate with senior leaders, portfolio companies, institutional stakeholders, strategic partners, and specialist advisers. Use data, digital tools, and approved AI solutions to improve the quality and efficiency of marketing delivery. Role purpose Create, translate, localise, and quality-check English and Arabic copy across group and portfolio communications, campaigns, presentations, digital channels, and stakeholder materials. The role ensures linguistic accuracy, brand consistency, and relevance for each audience. Key responsibilities Bilingual copywriting Write clear English and Arabic copy for campaigns, social media, websites, CRM, events, presentations, and corporate communications. Adapt tone for government, executive, partner, customer, and community audiences, and develop headlines, scripts, and calls to action. Translation and localisation Translate and localise content between English and Arabic while preserving meaning, tone, and intent. Maintain appropriate terminology across investment, government, technology, aviation, healthcare, fintech, and other portfolio sectors. Editing and quality assurance Proofread materials for grammar, clarity, consistency, and factual accuracy, and maintain bilingual style and terminology guides. Review final layouts for line breaks, punctuation, text direction, and Arabic typography, and keep language versions aligned. Executive and strategic content Support speeches, keynotes, briefing notes, executive presentations, and senior stakeholder materials. Work with content and storytelling colleagues to simplify complex language and create concise copy for infographics and strategic reports. AI-assisted language workflows Use approved AI and translation tools to support first drafts and terminology checks. Apply full human review and flag accuracy, cultural, or brand risks in machine-generated content. Key deliverables English and Arabic campaign copy Translated and localised materials Executive and stakeholder copy Bilingual style guide and terminology library Proofread final assets Website social and CRM copy Measures of success Translation accuracy Copy quality

Interpreter – Arabic/Sudanese Arabic | IRC - International Rescue Committee Interpreter – Arabic/Sudanese Arabic IRC - International Rescue Committee Remote | Baltimore International Junior level Speaks Arabic, English Apply Summary by Impactpool The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is seeking an Arabic/Sudanese Arabic Interpreter to provide accurate and confidential interpretation services for Limited English Proficient (LEP) individuals. The role involves in-person and remote interpretation in various settings, tracking assignments, and participating in trainings. Candidates should have a high school diploma, relevant interpretation experience, and cultural sensitivity. This position offers a chance to make a significant impact in the lives of individuals affected by humanitarian crises. Candidate Requirements: High school diploma preferred Interpretation certification preferred Relevant professional interpretation experience preferred Experience with refugee/immigrant populations preferred Cultural sensitivity Proficient in English Spoken proficiency in Arabic Attention to detail Basic computer skills Reliable transportation The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. This job posting was opened on 3/28/25. Please note that we will be prioritizing candidates who are current IRC (and recently employed by IRC) staff before other applicants. If necessary, we will extend the opportunity to external candidates.

deep_read.description: Freelance Translator | ICC - International Criminal Court Freelance Translator ICC - International Criminal Court Multiple locations Junior level Speaks English, French Apply Summary by Impactpool The International Criminal Court is seeking freelance translators to provide high-quality language services for court operations. Responsibilities include translating a variety of documents, ensuring accuracy and compliance with ICC standards, and collaborating with revisers and other translators. Candidates must possess a university degree in translation or a related field and have at least two years of relevant experience. Proficiency in specific language combinations and familiarity with legal terminology are essential. Candidate Requirements: University degree in translation, languages, law or relevant subject Two years of relevant work experience as a translator Mother-tongue proficiency in one language and high proficiency in another Ability to translate legal, political, military, medical, and technical documents Knowledge of legal concepts and international legal instruments Proficiency in MS Office Suite and CAT Tools Good organizational and time management skills Requisition ID 3861 - Posted - Professional - Language Services - Various Duty Stations 3861 | Registry Deadline for Applications: Open Organizational Unit: Language Services Section, Division of Judicial Services, Registry Duty Station: Various Duty Stations Type of Appointment: To be determined Minimum Net Annual Salary (Single Rate): To be determined Contract Duration: Variable length A roster of suitable candidates may be established for this post as a result of this selection process for both fixed-term established and general temporary assistance posts. Organisational Context Provision of high quality language services for efficient conduct of Court business: The Language Services Section (LSS) provides language services to the organs of the Court, i.e. translation, revision and editing of Court documents; consecutive and simultaneous interpretation for meetings, trial hearings, press conferences, specialised seminars, diplomatic briefings and other events, held in-house or away from the seat of the Court; assistance and guidance in terminology and references, management of language tools to make sure that consistent terminology is used in all the organs of the Court; recruitment, training, and accreditation of interpreters needed for work with Registry officials in the field and/or at the seat of the Court; provision of relevant information to service users to make them familiar with all the types of language services provided and with the procedures and requirements of the professions in question.
